M. Masaiah vs Sri Sridhar I A S on 11 January, 2024
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice J. Sreenivas Rao
 Contempt Case No.3368 of 2018
Order:
This Contempt Case is filed under Section 10 to 12 of Contempt of Courts Act to punish the
respondents for non-implementation of the interim order dated 10.10.2018, granted by this Court in
W.P.No.369

entities.text: M. Masaiah vs Sri Sridhar I A S
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
. 
2. Heard Sri B.Ashok, learned counsel, representing Sri M.Damodar Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue appearing on behalf of respondent Nos.1 to 3 and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Irrigation appearing on behalf of respondent No.4.
3.

The main grievance of the petitioners is that in spite of the specific directions granted by this Court on 10.10.2018, in I.A.No.1 of 2018 in W.P.No.36998 of 2018, respondents are dispossessing the petitioners from the subject property without following due process of law, without acquiring the petitioners' land initiated proceedings under the provisions of Act 30 of 2013.

4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Irrigation submits that respondents after following the due procedure as contemplated under the provisions of the Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013, passed Award on 27.02.2023, vide proceedings No.G2/2380/2021 and paid compensation in favour of the petitioners and placed a copy of the notice issued under Section 37(2) of RECTLARR Act, 2013 Act(30/2013).
5.

entities.text: Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In view of the same, no further adjudication is required.
6. Accordingly, the Contempt Case is closed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
